cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - TrafficLight
cc:Work.dc:description:
Traffic light
The traffic light was created to visualize the status of a Icinga monitored system.
When turned by 90°, it can be also used to create a bottle holder.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes TrafficLight --h 60 --depth 70 --shades 30 --n 4 --upright 0 --back_edge h --hole_dD 4 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes TrafficLight --h --depth --shades --n --upright --back_edge --hole_dD --thickness --reference --labels
